shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "dashkit|grid|dashboard" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -30

cat AGENTS.md | head -40; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -30; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; sed -n 189,210p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit 2>&1 | tail -15; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | grep -E '"version"|peerDep' -A8 | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/*/docs 2>/dev/null | head -30
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ node_modules | grep -E "icons|grid-layout"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md
sed -n 150,420p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md
sed -n 420,640p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build; grep -n "styles\|\.css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head

cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit && grep -n -i "import.*styles\|\.css\|\.scss" README.md | head; grep -n '"exports"' -A25 package.json | head -40; ls build/esm | head -30; cat build/esm/index.d.ts; grep -n "PluginDefinition\|interface PluginWidgetProps\|PluginProps" -r build/esm/shared/types/plugin.d.ts | head; cat build/esm/shared/types/plugin.d.ts | head -80; grep '"version"' ../icons/package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; grep -n '"sideEffects"' -A6 $D/package.json; cat $D/build/esm/typings/index.d.ts | head -60; ls $D/build/esm/plugins $D/build/esm/components; grep -n "interface PluginDefaultLayout\|PluginWidgetProps\|export interface Plugin\b" -r $D/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $D/typings/plugin.d.ts; sed -n 1,80p $D/typings/config.d.ts; cat $D/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "gridLayout\|interface DashkitOoui\|Settings" $D/typings/common.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "react-grid-layout/css\|import.*css" -r $D --include=*.js | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $D/shared/types/config.d.ts | head -70; cat $D/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.d.ts; sed -n 1,40p $D/typings/common.d.ts; grep -n "react-grid-layout" -i node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -5; grep -rn "react-grid-layout" $D/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js | head -3; grep -n "ItemDropProps" -B2 -A8 $D/shared/types/index.d.ts $D/shared/types/*.d.ts | head -30

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $D/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts; sed -n 1,40p $D/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts; cat $D/constants/index.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn "overlay-controls\|Remove\|Delete" $D/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/svgo 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(ChartColumn|Plus|Pencil|FloppyDisk|Xmark|ArrowsRotateRight|Check|TextAlignLeft|ChartLine|ChartPie|Heading|Hash|ListUl)\.js$"

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -E "^(ChartColumn|ChartLine|ChartPie|ChartArea|Plus|Pencil|Check|Xmark|ArrowRotateLeft|TextAlignLeft|Heading|ListUl|Hash|Gauge|Persons|ChartBar)\.js$"; cat package.json | grep -A8 '"dependencies"'

npm i @gravity-ui/icons 2>&1 | tail -2; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Progress Flex Text Label 2>&1 | head -40; sed -n 1,200p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | grep -n "variant\|Flex\|min-width" | head -20
sed -n 50,140p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Progress Label 2>&1 | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components && cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "value\|theme\|size\|text\|stack" Progress/Progress.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "theme\|size\|type" Label/Label.d.ts | head -12

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; F=$(find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o \( -name "Card.d.ts" -o -name "Progress.d.ts" -o -name "Label.d.ts" -o -name "types.d.ts" \) -print | grep -E "Card|Progress|Label" | head); echo "$F"
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; cat Progress/types.d.ts | head -40; sed -n 1,40p Label/Label.d.ts

grep -n "rowHeight" -r . --include=*.js | head -5; grep -n "pluginTitle\|pluginText" plugins/index.d.ts
